outcome: Time from DBC removal to delivery
Degree of cervical dilation after DBC removal
cohort: 58 pregnant women at 14 + 0 weeks to 27 + 6 weeks of gestation undergoing termination of pregnancy
finding: Extending the placement time of a double-balloon catheter from 12 to 24 hours in mid-trimester pregnancy terminations improves cervical ripening and reduces the need for dilation and evacuation.
